atoms.name: Fisher criterion
atoms.one_line: $J(w)=\dfrac{w^\top S_Bw}{w^\top S_Ww}$; scale of $w$ does not matter.

atoms.name: Projection and threshold
atoms.one_line: $z=w^\top x$; threshold at the midpoint of projected means for equal priors.

atoms.name: LDA as a Gaussian classifier
atoms.one_line: Shared $\Sigma$ gives a linear boundary; $\Sigma=\sigma^2I$ is nearest centroid.

atoms.name: LDA versus PCA
atoms.one_line: LDA is supervised (separation), PCA is unsupervised (variance).
